title: Catalog Video Templates
content_data:
> **Important**
By using Catalog API endpoints, you agree to the [Product Catalog Terms](https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/article?aid=6765817026859499525) and certify that you are abiding by the [TikTok Advertising Policies](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article?aid=6685586866860720134). Please review these policies and ensure that the items you upload to your catalog don't breach them. A catalog is an asset that allows you to store information about the products you want to promote on TikTok. Using a catalog is a great solution for anyone who is looking for an efficient way to create and manage ads that feature a variety of products, like an online retailer. Catalog Video Templates API enables you to retrieve catalog video packages in your Business Center. This group consists of the following endpoints: - [Get video packages](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740574099715073)
